messages.author: FikusMikus
messages.text: the field to select the number of units is gone

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@297362383226142720> which page is this on? (e.g. buying units on the military page, picking units for an attack, or buying buildings in a province) and is it on phone or desktop? i can't open the screenshot

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@297362383226142720> thanks. that's how attacks work now: when you pick ground, naval or air, your whole stack of that domain's units is sent automatically, so there's no amount field anymore (it only shows for single special units). if you'd like to choose how many units to send, post it in #suggestions and it'll go on the next ballot

messages.author: FikusMikus
messages.text: Ok so if i have too many units i can't attack

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@297362383226142720> yeah, right now an attack sends your whole stack of that domain, so a very big army can run into the supply limit. choosing how many units to send isn't a bug fix, it's a change to how attacks work, so post it in #suggestions and it'll go on the next ballot
